text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, Sweep Tosho enters the Classic division too.
It's sure to be even busier than last year.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiar, familiar! Come here quick!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, move your legs instead of your mouth!
Come on!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Led by the hand by a smiling Sweep Tosho,
I was brought to the hallway in front of the library.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ta-daaa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Where Sweep Tosho pointed,
the Umamusume's New Year calligraphy
was on display."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The goal that stood out the most among them was:
"To find the magic of racing"—
choice_data_list: Wow, Sweep has such beautiful handwriting...!
Wow, Sweep has such beautiful handwriting...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Fufun, right, right?♪

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Those are all wonderful goals.
...As for me—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Rob Roy!
Did you write down your resolution too!?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Huh? M-Me?
No, my resolutions aren't really grand enough to display...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~!?
You had a totally legit dream
of becoming a 'Hero', didn't you!?"

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? Sweep-san, shh! Shh!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: "B-Because just look at my results from last year. I took on the Classic Triple Crown route, but couldn't win a single one..."

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
……If anyone heard that dreaming of being a "hero"
was my goal, they'd laugh at me.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Just because people laugh at you
doesn't change what your dream is, does it?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Good grief.
I wondered who was making all that racket, and of course it's you lot.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...! Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry about the other day,
Sweep."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I offer my deepest apologies for my past behavior. Despite you telling me it was unnecessary, I ended up forcing my own ego onto you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This is not an apology, but
that flower you were fond of has produced seeds.
When you drop by the flower bed, I shall give you some.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Really!?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
However, gifts are only given until then.
I will not treat you the same on the racetrack.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: "If we ever face each other――I swear here and now that I won't treat you as a junior to protect, but as a fellow Umamusume, and beat you flat."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ......Races really are special after all, aren't they?
choice_data_list: You mean what Air Groove was talking about earlier?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "I mean, I've never seen her make a face like that before. How should I put it—"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —I got chills.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aha, it's just like Grandma said!
Racing really does have a special power!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I mean, if there's magic you can only use there,
it must be reeeaaally, really amazing!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ...Ms. Sweep is really strong, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Rob Roy? What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, I was just thinking that Sweep-san
looks a lot more like a hero than I do.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah! That's your goal, isn't it!?
My dream is to become a 'Witch who can use race magic'!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez, if you keep sulking around like that, I'll cast
a magic spell on you! Let's see here—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'm gonna cast a magic spell
that makes tons of power well up inside you! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Twinkle, twinkle☆
Spread throughout my whole body, source of power!
Hiyah!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"...See? You can feel the power surging now, right?
It's surging, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Tell me the hooonest truth, okay?
You're feeling all energized now, aren'tcha? Huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right? Right? Don't you think!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep Tosho was trying to brute-force her way through
with raw power rather than magic..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Right, with a vacation spell—wait—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Why is my familiar running the show?!
I'm the one who decides what magic I cast!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right. And while we're at it—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You're here already?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What?! So hurry up and give me the seeds!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, honestly.
We only just talked about it, you know.
Did you really think I'd have it ready already?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
I mean, it's Air Groove-san!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Also, I'm taking a few sprigs of thyme!
I need them for the magic potion I'm brewing next!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Alright, alright, take it.
You know where the pot is, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, we spent a leisurely
afternoon near the flower bed..."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
♪ Ooh, that sounds lovely!
Fufu, Rob Roy~, just give it up already...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Hyoooee...!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Tickle tickle tickle tickle tickleee!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Aha, haha... S-Sweep-san.
Ahaha, ahaha, a-are you... ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Haaah... haaah...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu~♪
You've cheered up quite a bit, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Then next is Sweep-san's turn...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Huh... Aaah, forget it, here goes!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ca... robre... Ahaha!
Ahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Sweep Tosho and Zenno Rob Roy spent a lovely New Year's together.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, familiar! Stop...
Stop Rob Roy... Ahahahahaha!
Come oooooon! Ahahahahaha!
